issues.legal_issue: The rate of interest on refunded payments for a flat that was not delivered depends on the circumstances of the case rather than a fixed rule.
material_facts: The applicant paid the installments required by the reservation letters on time.
The authority did not demand the remaining estimated cost after the last installment, did not deliver the flat, and gave assurances that possession would be provided.
After waiting for several years, the applicant sought a refund, which the authority made without interest.
The Commission awarded interest at 12% per annum, and the applicant appealed seeking a higher rate.
issues.conclusion: The Commission's award of interest at 12% per annum was appropriate in the circumstances, and the request for a higher rate was rejected.
issues.legal_principle: There is no hard and fast rule for the rate of interest; it depends on the facts and circumstances of each case. The applicant invoked Renusagar Power Co. Ltd. v. General Electric Co., 1994 Supp. (1) SCC 644, but the Court applied no fixed rate from that decision. The claim arose under Section 12B of the Monopolies and Restrictive Trade Practices Act, 1969.

rule.if: appeal_from_compensation_award and installments_paid_as_required and (flat_not_delivered_after_extended_wait or refund_made_without_interest)

predicates.appeal_from_compensation_award: The proceeding is an appeal from an award in a compensation claim arising from a service or trade practice dispute.
predicates.installments_paid_as_required: The applicant paid the installments demanded under the allotment arrangement on time.
predicates.flat_not_delivered_after_extended_wait: The promised flat was not delivered despite an extended wait and assurances of future possession.
predicates.refund_made_without_interest: The authority refunded the applicant's payments without paying interest.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns compensation after required payments were made but the promised flat was not delivered or the refund was made without interest, the interest rate is set as appropriate to the circumstances.

issues.legal_issue: When principal is refunded without the interest accrued during the period it was held, interest is also payable on that accrued interest.
material_facts: The authority held the applicant's installment payments while the promised flat was not delivered.
The authority refunded the principal without paying the interest awarded on the installments.
The Court directed the authority to pay interest at the same rate on the interest accrued on the installments, from the installment-payment dates until the refund date.
issues.conclusion: In addition to interest on the installments, the authority had to pay interest at the same rate on that interest for the period the principal remained unpaid.
issues.legal_principle: Interest is the normal accretion on capital, not a penalty or punishment. Equity requires a party that retained another's money to return not only the principal but also the benefit represented by interest; where accrued interest was not paid with the principal, interest is payable on that accrued interest as well.

predicates.appeal_from_compensation_award: The proceeding is an appeal from an award in a compensation claim arising from a service or trade practice dispute.
predicates.principal_refunded_without_accrued_inter: The party holding the applicant's money refunded the principal without paying the interest accrued on it.
predicates.funds_held_during_period_before_refund: The party retained the applicant's money for a period before refunding it.

issues.definition: If a party in a compensation dispute refunds retained principal without its accrued interest after holding the funds for a period, interest is payable on the accrued interest.
